purpose: Calibration baseline for the 2004-05 game engine. A season is simulated on the environment of the last completed season, never on its own final averages.

verification.method: Read from the Basketball-Reference 2003-04 season page League Average rows (Per Game, Totals and Advanced team tables) by an automated parser. Per-game values cross-checked against the Totals row; ORtg recomputed from points and pace. No player-totals file for 2003-04 was supplied, so player-rate baselines and the team-turnover residual are not included.

sources.notes: League Average row of the Per Game Stats team table; pace and four factors from the Advanced Stats team table League Average row.

engine_assumptions.status: provisional structural assumptions, not sourced league data
engine_assumptions.note: Copied unchanged from the 2002-03 file's structure; not researched.
